title: Neo-Hookean cube stretched to λ = 1.5: explicit dynamics, loaded slowly, against the implicit nonlinear solver
source: Uniaxial stress of a compressible neo-Hookean solid (Holzapfel, Nonlinear Solid Mechanics, Wiley 2000, §6.5): a homogeneous state that a quasi-static explicit run must share with the implicit Newton solution on the same material point; the implicit solver is itself checked against the closed form by nl-neo-hookean-uniaxial

quantities.quantity: lateral displacement of the corner (1, 1, 1) along y, explicit over implicit
quantities.reason: the same material point and a homogeneous state; the explicit run is pulled over a few hundred wave transits, and what is left of its waves is a fraction of a percent

quantities.quantity: σ_xx of element 1, explicit, over σ_xx at the node at (0, 0, 0), implicit
